strings.name: Zhou Hongyi
strings.role: Chairman and general manager of 360 Security Technology
strings.summary: Zhou Hongyi is a Chinese internet entrepreneur, a co-founder of Qihoo 360 and the chairman and general manager of 360 Security Technology. He founded 3721 and led Yahoo China before developing 360’s security software and internet businesses. His career also encompasses a US listing, privatization, an A-share restructuring and competition litigation with Tencent.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Incorporation, personal appointments and listing restructurings are distinguished. Corporate civil litigation is not personal criminal liability. AI opinions and application accounts are not independently verified performance findings.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Qihoo 360, advancing the commercialization of internet security software and online services and influencing China’s consumer cybersecurity market.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor’s degree in computer software from Xi’an Jiaotong University in 1992 and master’s degree in systems engineering in 1995.
strings.facts.f2.label: Founding and appointment dates
strings.facts.f2.value: Qihoo was incorporated in 2005; filings date Zhou’s appointment as chairman and CEO to August 2006.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Security software and internet businesses
strings.highlights.h1.text: Developed Qihoo 360 with co-founders including Qi Xiangdong, advancing consumer security products and internet services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Technology and management discussion
strings.highlights.h2.text: A 2026 Xi’an Jiaotong University report describes his campus discussions on AI tools, management innovation and education; these are views shared in discussion.
strings.timeline.t1.title: University reports his return
strings.timeline.t1.text: Xi’an Jiaotong University reports a recent discussion with students and faculty about AI and management; this is the publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: 360 returns to A-shares after restructuring
strings.timeline.t2.text: 360 Security Technology holds its listing ceremony at the Shanghai Stock Exchange under code 601360.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Qihoo privatization merger completed
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company announces completion and requests suspension of New York ADS trading; delisting procedures are separate.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Antitrust appeal dismissed
strings.timeline.t4.text: The Supreme People’s Court upholds dismissal of Qihoo’s claims against Tencent; this is civil litigation between companies.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Qihoo ADSs list in New York
strings.timeline.t5.text: Qihoo 360 American depositary shares begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange as QIHU.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becomes Qihoo chairman and CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: Filings date the start of his tenure to this month; co-founders include Qi Xiangdong.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Leads Yahoo China
strings.timeline.t7.text: His tenure continues through August 2005, following Yahoo’s acquisition of 3721.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds 3721
strings.timeline.t8.text: Builds an internet search and online marketing business, later acquired by Yahoo.
